text:
AVR::enable
Description
Enables the AVR plugin for the current connection. AVR will remain
enabled on the current connection until it is closed or
AVR::disable
is called. Note that enabling AVR
alone within the iRule only ensures the message reaches the AVR
plugin, it doesn’t ensure that statistics will be gathered.
Syntax
AVR
::
enable
Examples
Related Information

ALL_EVENTS
